coverage.reason: Verify sandbox-only Stripe session creation, immutable quotes, account ownership and verification, raw signed webhooks, lost-response and concurrent retries, wallet overflow and atomic exactly-once test credits. Existing cosmetics tests protect the separate playable wallet, purchase authority and permanent ownership.

Pin the Stripe SDK and exercise its signature verification, while retaining locked Firebase dependency regression coverage and real Firestore transaction integration. Production dependency audit runs because the dependency files changed.

Check the checkout in the actual Shop at desktop and landscape mobile, including popup blocking, saved-order retry, pending/confirmed receipt, malicious redirects and late account responses. Existing cosmetics coverage verifies unrelated Shop/Profile spending, free switching, artwork and auth-session behavior.

Build and verify delivery, immutable cache parity and release fingerprints for the new checkout assets and static return page. Smoke-test production pages and run the actual Shop to catch missing globals, broken loading or layout integration.
Record the confirmed Stripe selection, disabled sandbox implementation status and remaining merchant/pricing/live-launch setup. Documentation does not approve fixture prices or change gameplay.
